heading: •••Jedi Survivor (V)
game_text: When deployed, you may not initiate battle here this turn. While at opponent’s site, adds one {light-force} and one {dark-force}. May ‘swing’ lightsabers for free. May never be won in sabacc. Immune to attrition < 5. End of your turn: {icon:maintenance-star} Use 1 or {icon:maintenance-flag} Lose 1 or {icon:maintenance-skull}.

When deployed, you may not initiate battle here
this turn. While at opponent’s site, adds one {light-force}

never be won in sabacc. Immune to attrition < 5.
End of your turn: {icon:maintenance-star} Use 1 or {icon:maintenance-flag} Lose 1 or {icon:maintenance-skull}.
base_lore: Careful manipulator of funds and Imperial taxation codes. Buys droids from Jawas and sells them to the Alliance.

notes: Group: Everything Else. COMBO / FULL-CARD OVERLAY (755×1101) over Droid Merchant. Title bar: the Alien disc (black disc, two yellow eyes — as printed), '•••Jedi Survivor', destiny 3. LORE printed by the slip: 'Female.' (replaces the base lore, kept in base_lore). Right of the lore box: Special Edition ring (as printed) + black EPISODE I disc added → ring_icons ['episode1']. Art window blank. Stats POWER 5 / ABILITY 6 / JEDI KNIGHT (label only); deploy 5 / forfeit 5. Icon column: warrior (weapon on cyan, Game Aid g029); then VS16 sphere. No credits. INLINE ICONS: 'adds one [blue saber square] and one [red saber square]' = the Light Force and Dark Force icons (Game Aid g036 / g050) → {light-force} / {dark-force}; the stub reads them as 'battle destiny' / 'destiny to total power' (interpretation, not what is printed). Last line prints Decipher's three maintenance glyphs: a black six-pointed star before 'Use 1' → {icon:maintenance-star}; an outlined pennant/flag glyph before 'Lose 1' → {icon:maintenance-flag} (NEW glyph, not seen in earlier sets — needs a cut from the sheet); skull-and-crossbones before the period → {icon:maintenance-skull}; each followed/preceded by a space as printed (stub: 'Use 1 Force or Lose 1 Force or N'). Curly ’ and ‘swing’ as printed. Layout matches the printed card's proportions. CHANGES vs printed Droid Merchant (SE, •••, Alien): title, lore, Episode I icon; POWER 1 → 5, ABILITY 2 → 6, third box blank → JEDI KNIGHT; deploy 1 → 5, forfeit 3 → 5; warrior icon added; text replaced (printed: 'Cumulatively activates 1 Force each time you deploy a droid (or retrieves 1 Force when you deploy an astromech to a starfighter). Spaceport Speeders may be played at same site (place droid in Used Pile instead of Lost Pile).'). Base lore matches both scans. art.src = the 350 px printed archive face; the 745 px SE-L-droidmerchant.gif (also downloaded) is the PC Errata face (D-E1 tag) — art only; SE 1998 copyright legible on it. Modern: VB5-L-jedisurvivor-pre.gif (Virtual Block 5 reissue).
